description: Shortest paths between 74 pairs of points of interest in Goldendale, WA, under the four traveller profiles of the TDEI quality reports.
r5: TDEI quality reports test run of 2026-10-07 against R5 with the ws-prod profile, at 1.3 m/s
accessMap: https://www.accessmap.app/api/v1/routing/shortest_path/custom.json fetched 2026-10-07. Its Goldendale region is TDEI dataset 47d39ea1-86d6-4fea-bf7d-06484ac241fe (Goldendale, WA 1.5), not the dataset above. It has no fan mode.
metersFromNetwork: The distance from the origin or the destination, whichever is farther, to the nearest edge of the dataset.
